recommendation.rationale: Noncovalent interactions dominate molecular/organic crystals; PBE-D3(BJ) is a robust cost/accuracy default. Consider B97-3c or r2SCAN-D4 for better thermochemistry when affordable.
caveats: For gas-phase reaction barriers, hybrid functionals such as M06-2X or wB97X-D are preferred.
references: Grimme et al., J. Chem. Phys. 132, 154104 (2010)

recommendation.rationale: Metal surfaces and adsorption energies need a van der Waals density functional; optB88-vdW is a good balance for lattice constants and adsorption. RPBE-D3 or PBE-D3(BJ) are common alternatives.
caveats: Check lattice constant against experiment; optB88-vdW can underbind some transition metals.
Use PAW datasets with high ENMAX; set ENCUT >= 1.3 * max ENMAX.
references: Klimes et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 22, 022201 (2010)

recommendation.rationale: For accurate band gaps and defect levels use HSE06; for fast geometry optimization use PBE/PBEsol first and refine with HSE06.
caveats: HSE06 is much more expensive; use reduced k-meshes and restart from PBE wavefunctions when possible.
For lattice constants PBEsol is usually better than PBE.
references: Heyd, Scuseria, Ernzerhof, J. Chem. Phys. 118, 8207 (2003)

recommendation.rationale: d/f-electron localization requires PBE+U or HSE06. PBE+U is a practical default for transition-metal oxides and battery cathodes; SCAN/r2SCAN is a modern parameter-free alternative.
caveats: Hubbard U is element and oxidation-state dependent; calibrate against experiments or benchmark literature.
Combine with D3(BJ) for layered/host-guest systems.
references: Dudarev et al., Phys. Rev. B 57, 1505 (1998)

recommendation.rationale: Optical/electronic spectra usually require a screened hybrid (HSE06) or many-body GW/BSE. TDDFT with a range-separated hybrid is preferred for molecular excited states.
caveats: HSE06 underestimates excitonic effects; GW/BSE is the next step.
Molecular TDDFT: CAM-B3LYP or wB97X-D often outperform global hybrids.

recommendation.rationale: PBEsol improves lattice constants and elastic properties over PBE at similar cost.
caveats: PBEsol can worsen atomization energies; use PBE for chemistry and PBEsol for solid-state geometry.
references: Perdew et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 100, 136406 (2008)

recommendation.rationale: Use PBE-D3(BJ) for metal-catalyzed reaction paths; for small-molecule organic reactions prefer M06-2X or wB97X-D. NEB/CI-NEB input cards inherit these settings.
caveats: Barrier heights are sensitive to the functional; validate against CCSD(T) benchmarks when possible.
